name: Hornero Calculator
description: Utility Tools 2.0 calculator: bar quick action and compact dashboard detail over a safe tokenizer/recursive-descent parser (+ - * / %, parentheses, decimals, unary minus). Division by zero shows Error.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Popover: one short hint instead of two developer notes that overflowed the popout.
Bar quick action joins the native quick actions island (section actions). Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.73 (bar sections).
Native look: card header with the calculate icon, icon-only bar button, tonal keypad with a primary "=". Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.72 (PluginKit UiIcon/iconName/card header).
Dashboard keypad uses tonal keys with "=" as the primary action, matching native shell controls (needs the PluginKit tonal button variant; older shells show filled keys).

Utility Tools 2.0 (plugins#30): bar quick action with popover, compact Utilities dashboard detail panel and a declaration-only launcher entrypoint (not loaded until shell#250) over one tested pure-JS logic block; typed settings default to 1.x behaviour; Spanish catalog.
Dashboard calculator with a safe tokenizer and recursive-descent parser; division by zero showed Error.

showKeypad.description: Show the keypad grid in the dashboard panel (the 1.x behaviour).

liveResult.description: Recompute the bar quick action as you type; off keeps 1.x explicit compute on Enter or =.
